text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, as Christmas was drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(How strange.
To think I don't hate the bustling crowd...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...Last year's Christmas. Ever since then, perhaps?
Could it be thanks to those girls...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Then... I can't just be the one receiving.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Finding out there was a Christmas market being held, I decided to check it out.
There, I happened to spot a familiar face—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...!
You came too, I see.
choice_data_list: I'm here to look at Christmas goods. How about you, Admire Vega?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Something like that. Ideas for a thank-you gift.
At last year's Christmas party, those girls acted as the hosts, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...I'm the host this year. So, don't we need a little something? Like the right atmosphere, a special vibe... That's why I'm scouting it out."
choice_data_list: In that case, let's look around together.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... I don't mind, though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Gingerbread cookies, gingerbread houses...
I suppose these are the standard choices.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I hope it suits your taste.
choice_data_list: Why not ask for a sample?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. Since we're serving food, I want it to be delicious.
Excuse me—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Going so far as to dress up like this... I'm getting a bit carried away.
Though I suppose it does feel like Christmas.
choice_data_list: I'll wear it too, so it'll be fine!
I'll wear it too, so don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fufu... What is that even supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I watched over Admire Vega as she prepared for the Christmas party...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy~abe-san!!
Thank you for having me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, those outfits...!
Trainer, you're matching with her too!
They look great on you! Both of you look wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... but are you sure it's okay
for you to do all this for me...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... to think even I would be invited...
even though I'm everyone's barrier...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, don't worry about it.
...You helped out with the preparations
for last year's Christmas party, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Since then...
I feel like my perspective has changed a bit—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Christmas was something
I always spent alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“Yet all of you taught me
that there are other moments besides those.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So――this is my thanks.
In return for the time you gave me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...What quite a surprise.
Ayabe-san, I received it loud and clear!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Or rather, in that case, I'll return those exact same words to you!
Thank you so much, as always!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If you repay my gratitude with more gratitude,
I won't know what to do with myself.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to convey it.
I'm glad you were able to convey it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: We're not just placing the order. I'll bring the food over too, so everyone stay right here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need your help.
Stay seated."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're a guest today too, you know.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's gather around the food and take a commemorative photo!
Got it! I'll be waiting on an empty stomach!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I moved to aim the camera I had brought, Admire Vega stopped me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you won't be in the picture like that.
...It won't match the image quality, but
a smartphone will do."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A photo was posted in the LANE group.
A picture illuminated by candlelight, a true portrait of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Same here! I'm really looking forward to your hospitality, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This looks like it'll be a wonderful dinner!
How about an impromptu opera of gratitude to celebrate!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.
